item.title: Korda defies cold, wind to lead LPGA opener
item.description: Nelly Korda grabbed a three-stroke lead in Saturday's weather-halted third round of the season-opening LPGA Tournament of Champions.

item.title: Rose powers to six-shot lead at Torrey Pines
item.description: Justin Rose fired seven birdies in another dominant display on Torrey Pines' formidable South Course on Saturday.

item.title: Schott wins maiden title in Bahrain playoff
item.description: Freddy Schott won his first DP World Tour title after beating Calum Hill and Patrick Reed in a playoff at the Bapco Energies Bahrain Championship.

item.title: Viljoen claims SDC Open in dramatic playoff
item.description: MJ Viljoen claimed a dramatic playoff victory in the SDC Open at the Zebula Golf Estate & Spa on Sunday, securing his first title on the HotelPlanner Tour.

item.title: Rose rolls to Torrey Pines win in record fashion
item.description: Justin Rose set a 72-hole tournament record to capture the PGA Tour's Farmers Insurance Open at Torrey Pines by seven strokes.

item.title: Sunshine Ladies Tour big part of Alexander’s prep
item.description: South Africa’s Casandra Alexander believes the Sunshine Ladies Tour is fast becoming the main pathway onto the Ladies European Tour for the world’s women professionals.

item.title: Rahm backs player freedom after LIV defections
item.description: Jon Rahm says golfers should be free to choose to play "where they want", following the latest defection from LIV Golf ahead of the season opener in Riyadh this week.

item.title: Westwood to miss opening LIV Golf events
item.description: Lee Westwood will miss the opening two events of the 2026 LIV Golf season after withdrawing due to a wrist injury.

item.title: LIV Golf unhappy with ranking points ‘restriction’
item.description: LIV Golf has welcomed the Official World Golf Ranking’s decision to award points to its events from 2026, but says the move does not go far enough.

item.title: Sattelkau sets early pace at Humewood
item.description: Germany’s Celina Sattelkau carded a three-under 69 to lead the SuperSport Ladies Challenge after a delayed opening round at Humewood Golf Club.
